correctness.rationale: The unique-gcd four-factor decomposition restricts exactly to pairwise-coprime squarefree components when the product is squarefree; degree balances are k,k,n-k,n-k. The exact multivariate Euler coefficient formula is derived formally. Linear local terms cancel in H, so its analytic radius in each coordinate exceeds 1; Cauchy estimates justify all interchanges, the constants, and the O_q((n+1)^4 q^(-n/4)) tail. Two independent finite counting methods agree for 17 cases (q=2,3,5), not used as a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Squarefree common products are a natural arithmetic stratification of multiplicative energy recently counted without this restriction. The new theorem gives exact leading and secondary Euler-product invariants at fixed field size, plus an exponentially accurate degree-asymptotic remainder and a reusable exact coefficient identity. It is not merely a restatement of pairwise coprimality or a low-degree table.
